segments.name: Human Health
segments.description: Develops and commercializes human products, including Mytesi, an approved treatment for non-infectious diarrhea in adults with HIV/AIDS.
segments.evidence: The human health segment is focused on developing and commercializing human products and the ongoing commercialization of Mytesi, which the US FDA approves for the symptomatic relief of non-infectious diarrhea in adults with HIV/AIDS on antiretroviral therapy.

segments.name: Animal Health
segments.description: Develops and commercializes prescription and non-prescription products for companion and production animals.
segments.evidence: The animal health segment is focused on developing and commercializing prescription and non-prescription products for companion and production animals.

revenueModel.text: Woodward Specialty LLC, an affiliate of Future Pak, pays Napo upfront and milestone payments for US rights to Mytesi and Canalevia.
revenueModel.evidence: Under the license agreement, Licensee shall pay Napo an upfront payment of $ 18 million, consisting of $ 16.0 million paid on the effective date, and $ 2.0 million payable upon satisfaction of specified conditions, as well as up to $ 17.0 million, with respect to the first occurrence of each of the milestones specified in the license agreement.
